983: fn redact_sensitive_path(uri: &axum::http::Uri) -> String {
984:     let path = uri.path();
985:     let safe_path = if path.starts_with("/api/v1/public/views/") {
986:         "/api/v1/public/views/[REDACTED]"
987:     } else {
988:         path
989:     };
990: 
991:     let query = uri.query().unwrap_or("");
992:     if query.is_empty() {
993:         return safe_path.to_owned();
994:     }
995: 
996:     let mut has_redaction = false;
997:     let redacted_pairs: Vec<String> = query
998:         .split('&')
999:         .map(|pair| {
1000:             if let Some((key, _)) = pair.split_once('=')
1001:                 && SENSITIVE_QUERY_KEYS.contains(&key)
1002:             {
1003:                 has_redaction = true;
1004:                 return format!("{key}=[REDACTED]");
1005:             }
1006:             pair.to_owned()
1007:         })
1008:         .collect();
1009: 
1010:     if has_redaction {
1011:         format!("{}?{}", safe_path, redacted_pairs.join("&"))
1012:     } else {
1013:         safe_path.to_owned()
1014:     }
1015: }

238: fn frontend_content_type(path: &FsPath) -> &'static str {
239:     match path.extension().and_then(|extension| extension.to_str()) {

241:         Some("js") => "text/javascript; charset=utf-8",
242:         Some("json") | Some("map") => "application/json; charset=utf-8",
243:         Some("svg") => "image/svg+xml",
244:         Some("png") => "image/png",
245:         Some("jpg") | Some("jpeg") => "image/jpeg",

770: fn build_application_router(state: ApplicationState) -> Router {
771:     let mut router = Router::new()
772:         .route("/health/live", get(health_live))
773:         .route("/health/ready", get(health_ready))
774:         .route("/api/v1/auth/invitations/consume", post(consume_invitation))
775:         .route("/api/v1/auth/invitations/preview", get(preview_invitation))
776:         .route("/api/v1/auth/login-links", post(request_login_link))
777:         .route("/api/v1/auth/login-links/consume", post(consume_login_link))
778:         .fallback(not_found);
779:     if state.password_login_enabled {
780:         router = router.route("/api/v1/auth/password-login", post(password_login));
781:     }
782:     if std::env::var("APP_ENV").ok().as_deref() == Some("development") {
783:         router = router.route("/api/v1/dev/login", get(dev_login));
784:     }
785:     if state.shared_view_service.is_some() && state.event_service.is_some() {
786:         let mut public = Router::new()
787:             .route("/api/v1/public/views/:token", get(read_public_view))
788:             .route(
789:                 "/api/v1/public/views/:token/events",
790:                 get(list_public_view_events),
791:             )
792:             .route("/api/v1/public/views/:token/feed.ics", get(feed_ics))
793:             .layer(middleware::from_fn(public_response_headers));
794:         if let Some(limiter) = state.public_rate_limiter.clone() {
795:             public = public.layer(middleware::from_fn_with_state(
796:                 limiter,
797:                 crate::public_rate_limit::public_rate_limit_middleware,
798:             ));
799:         }
800:         router = router.merge(public);
801:     }
802:     if let Some(manager) = state.session_manager.clone() {
803:         let mut protected = Router::new()
804:             .route(
805:                 "/api/v1/auth/session",
806:                 get(inspect_session).delete(logout_current),
807:             )
808:             .route("/api/v1/auth/sessions", axum::routing::delete(logout_all));
809:         if state.admin_service.is_some() {
810:             protected = protected
811:                 .route("/api/v1/admin/users", get(list_users))
812:                 .route("/api/v1/admin/invitations", post(invite_user))
813:                 .route("/api/v1/admin/invitations/:id", delete(revoke_invitation))
814:                 .route(
815:                     "/api/v1/admin/invitations/:id/resend",
816:                     post(resend_invitation),
817:                 )
818:                 .route("/api/v1/admin/users/:id/suspend", post(suspend_user))
819:                 .route("/api/v1/admin/users/:id/reactivate", post(reactivate_user))
820:                 .route("/api/v1/admin/users/:id/promote", post(promote_user))
821:                 .route("/api/v1/admin/users/:id/demote", post(demote_user))
822:                 .route(
823:                     "/api/v1/admin/users/:id/revoke-sessions",
824:                     post(revoke_user_sessions),
825:                 );
826:         }
827:         if state.user_invitation_service.is_some() {

983: fn redact_sensitive_path(uri: &axum::http::Uri) -> String {
984:     let path = uri.path();
985:     let safe_path = if path.starts_with("/api/v1/public/views/") {
986:         "/api/v1/public/views/[REDACTED]"
987:     } else {
988:         path
989:     };
990: 
991:     let query = uri.query().unwrap_or("");
992:     if query.is_empty() {
993:         return safe_path.to_owned();
994:     }
995: 
996:     let mut has_redaction = false;
997:     let redacted_pairs: Vec<String> = query
998:         .split('&')
999:         .map(|pair| {
1000:             if let Some((key, _)) = pair.split_once('=')
1001:                 && SENSITIVE_QUERY_KEYS.contains(&key)
1002:             {
1003:                 has_redaction = true;
1004:                 return format!("{key}=[REDACTED]");
1005:             }
1006:             pair.to_owned()
1007:         })
1008:         .collect();
1009: 
1010:     if has_redaction {
1011:         format!("{}?{}", safe_path, redacted_pairs.join("&"))
1012:     } else {
1013:         safe_path.to_owned()
1014:     }
1015: }
